dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Feb 19 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000penh](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000penh) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 19 2025 9km NE of Kulumadau. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -9.0615 longitude 152.799. It impacted 1643 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
